Commentary.Commentary: Well, that's it from the 1st ODI then. What a thrilling way to get underway in the ODI series. We had a nail-biter of a finish, where Pakistan showed all class. And there are 2 more ODIs on the way. The second one begins at 12 PM Local (0700 GMT) on Sunday, 1st November 2020. We hope to have your company for that. Until then, take care and goodbye from our side.

Babar Azam, Pakistan's VICTORIOUS SKIPPER, says that he was expecting a close finish like this. States that Zimbabwe batted well. Admits that from Pakistan's side their opening with the bat was not good. Will sit and discuss that and see to improve that, he says. Says further that in the first innings, it was two-paced and hence he struggled. On reserving Afridi and Riaz towards the end, Azam states that the duo performed really well. Says that Riaz is an experienced player and Afridi is also slowly becoming one.

Chamu Chibhabha, Zimbabwe's captain, says that the Pakistani bowlers put them under pressure towards the end and deserve credit for the same. States that Zimbabwe's bowlers bowled well, especially to the Pakistani openers. Admits honestly though that after a good start with the ball, they allowed it to slip away in the end. Praises Wesley Madhevere for his good knock. States that they need to keep such a momentum going forward as well.

Brendan Taylor is the MAN OF THE MATCH, 110 runs from 117 balls. Says that the plan was to try and bat well throughout. Adds that the Pakistani bowling was really good. On Wesley's knock, Brendan agrees it was a very good knock from Madhevere. States that Wesley was enjoying himself out in the middle. Adds that the pace slowed down later and that the Zimbabwe batters had to put more effort. Given the tough bowling prowess of Pakistan, it was imperative for Zimbabwe to bat well, he says.
Please stay tuned for the presentation ceremony.

Earlier, after winning the toss, Pakistan opted to bat first. They started off on a sluggish note, lost wickets in the middle but picked up fairly well in the end to get to 281/8. One would wonder that was not enough given their batting prowess but their bowlers proved that notion wrong. They struck early and struck back again to dismiss Madhevere and Taylor and then seal the deal in the hosts' favour.

Pakistan's bowlers were splendid with the ball. They more than made up for their batsmen's shortcomings. This wicket had everything for the pacers and that was proven right by the Pakistani pacers. Afridi and Riaz, 9 wickets amongst them, the former picked up 5 and the latter 4. Besides that, they kept a tight noose on the scoring rate as well. Apart from them, Wasim bowled decently and got a wicket. Rauf and Ashraf were a touch expensive and unfortunately, could not manage anything in this game.

Chasing 282 for a win, Zimbabwe got off to a shaky start as they lost a wicket in just the 3rd ball of the chase. They lost another shortly but that did not dampen their scoring rate, which was going decently well. But it slowed down in the middle again and the required rate started picking up. Ervine and Williams fell later on. But Taylor and Madhevere stitched an excellent partnership of 119 to put Zimbabwe in close contention. But they both fell in quick succession and after that it was all downhill for Zimbabwe as the rest crumbled like shortbread, handing Pakistan a 26 run win in the end.

Wahab Riaz and Shaheen Afridi share 9 wickets between them and blow away Zimbabwe. What a valiant effort from the latter. Congratulations all around in the Pakistan dressing room. But there is a lot for Zimbabwe to take from this game as well.

OUT! BOWLED! Wahab finishes things in style! Execution of fast yorker from these two Pakistani bowlers. This time it is Riaz. A near-perfect yorker. Muzarabani fails to dig out and the stumps behind are shattered. Pakistan win by 26 runs.
Play and a miss. A good length ball outside off, Muzarabani looks to pull but misses.
Good change of pace. Full and outside off, Muzarabani looks to drive but is beaten for the slower one.
FOUR! That will help. Full and around off and middle, Blessing nails the drive straight past the bowler for a boundary. Need to keep them coming though.
A single to end a fantastic spell. Full and around off, pushed towards the off side for one. 5/49 from Afridi.
Full and outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Blessing Muzarabani is the last man in for Zimbabwe.

OUT! TIMBER! FIFER FOR AFRIDI! A terrific yorker and Chisoro has no answer. Full, fast and straight. You miss, I hit delivery from Afridi. Chisoro backs away again but this time fails to make any connection. The off pole takes the beating.
EDGED AND FOUR! Good length ball just outside off, Chisoro backs away and looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge that flies over the keeper for a boundary.
A brilliant yorker on middle, Chisoro does well to keep it out.
Richard Ngarava is the new man in at the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Shaheen gets his 4th. Zimbabwe are falling apart here. Mumba is the latest one to depart. Wahab Riaz with a fine catch. Full and outside off, Mumba looks to launch it over mid off but mistimes it. It is just over Wahab at mid off. He does well to take a couple of steps behind and hold onto the catch.
Another dot! Brilliant over from Wahab. Just 2 runs and a wicket. Chisoro backs away again, this time Wahab delivers it wide. He fails to reach out and connect. 36 runs needed in last 12 balls.
DOT! Very full and on middle, Chisoro backs away and looks to drill it through the off side but gets an inside edge on the pad.
A single now as this one is driven little wide of the mid off fielder for one.
Good length and around off, pushed towards mid off for nothing.
Carl Mumba comes to the middle now.

OUT! Knocks him over! Wahab gets another one. Raza goes now and the hopes of Zimbabwe takes a massive dive. Change of pace from Wahab. It is on a good length and on middle, Raza looks to defend but is beaten for pace. He misses and the ball does not. It rattles the stumps behind.
A single on the first ball. Just outside off on a good length, pushed to deep point for one.

EDGY FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler but an important boundary for Zimbabwe. A perfect yorker around off, Raza somehow manages to get his bat down in time. It takes a thick outside edge and races away to the third man fence. 38 needed in 18 balls.
Who will walk out to bat now? Tendai Chisoro it is, at No. 8.

OUT! TAKEN! Taylor falls. A massive, massive moment in the game. The asking rate was getting big and Taylor had to go. A full ball just outside off, Taylor looks to launch it over the off side but the ball hits the toe end and balloons towards mid off. Wahab there settles under it and takes it easily. A top knock from Taylor comes to an end. He would've loved to take the team home but has perished. 42 needed in 19 balls.
Short and outside off, Raza makes room and looks to lift it over mid off but fails to get the timing right. Just a single.
Excellent yorker! Raza does well to keep it out towards point. A dot.
Short and outside off, it is pulled towards mid on for one.

Quick run! Good legngth ball around off, Raza pushes it towards point and calls for a quick run. Taylor responds. Imam quickly gets to the ball and underarms the throw at the striker's end but misses.
Short and around off, Raza pulls it down to deep mid-wicket and gets a single. Just the 3 runs and the big wicket of Madhevere off it. 45 needed in 24 balls.
Short and wide outside off, punched towards the cover fielder for one.
Taylor looks to pull by moving towards the off side but misses as the ball goes over the stumps.
Good length and around off, Raza pushes it through point and gets to the other end.
Sikandar Raza comes to the middle now.

OUT! TIMBER! Wahab strikes! Pakistan will hope that this opens the floodgates for them. Shortish ball on off and middle, Madhevere looks to pull but he is a bit early in the shot. He misses and the ball sneaks below his bat to disturb the stumps. 48 runs needed in 28 balls still for the visitors.
Good length and around off, Madhevere looks to pull but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Wahab Riaz is back to bowl as Haris Rauf has completed his quota of overs. 7-0-32-1 for Riaz. Can he get these two here?
Dot! Short and around off, Taylor goes hard for the pull but the ball hits the upper half and goes back to the bowler. 48 needed in 30 balls.
Beaten. Length ball around off, shapes away and beats the outside edge.

FOUR! WOW! What a shot that is from Taylor. This is extra-ordinary batting from him. Another full ball on the stumps, Taylor once again moves away to make room and then opens the bat face and lifts it over short third man for a boundary. A reverse scoop over short third man. Yes, a reverse scoop if we can call it that name.
FOUR! WOW! This is brilliant batting from Taylor. Makes room by backing away and gets under the full ball around off and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary. 10th boundary for Taylor.
WIDE! Afridi misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. Taylor looks to work it on the leg side but misses. Wided.

Full and around middle, Taylor lifts it over the bowler's head. The mid off fielder is inside the ring. He gives it a chase and stops the ball with a slide. Third umpire confirms that it is a clean stop.
Full and on middle, it is flicked towards mid-wicket.
Imad Wasim is done with his 10 overs. Shaheen Afridi is back. 7-0-26-2 for him. Can he add to that impressive numbers? Especially in the last column?

CENTURY FOR TAYLOR! What a sensational innings this has been from the experienced man. His first against Pakistan and 11th in his ODI career. What a player. Good length ball around off, he pushes it towards point. Wesley thinks for the single but Taylor sends him back. The point fielder fires the throw at the non-striker's end but misses. There is no one doing backup and they eventually get the run in the form of an overthrow. Taylor takes the helmet off and celebrates.
Good length and around off, it is blocked.
Short and outside off, it is slapped through cover-point for one.
A single and Taylor moves to 99. Good length and around off, he pushes it towards the off side and goes for a quick run.
Length ball around off, Wesley taps it towards cover and calls for a quick run. Gets it.
Full and wide outside off, pushed towards point.
Haris Rauf to bowl out. 9-1-53-0 for him. Can he get a much-needed wicket for his side?
Full and outside off, swept to deep square leg for one. 7 off the over.
Floated around off, Wesley skips down the track and makes room to play an inside out stroke but gets an inside edge on the pad.
Flatter and on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Full and outside off, forced to sweeper cover for one.

FOUR! There's the one boundary that needs. Poor delivery form Imad. It is full and down the leg side. Wesley sweeps it hard through square leg and gets the boundary. He gets to a well-made 50 and the partnership between these two is also worh a 100 runs now.
Leading edge! Full and on middle, Madhevere looks to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge towards point. Luckily for Zimbabwe, no damage there.
Dot to end another decent over for Zimbabwe. Full and around off, Taylor keeps it out off his front foot. 70 needed in 48 balls.
Full and around off, driven wide of the mid off fielder for one.

FOUR! SHOT! Madhevere is playing an excellent hand here. Short and wide outside off, Madhevere gets on top of the bounce and punches it wide of the man at mid off. It beats him and races away to the fence.
Landed around middle on a good length, Taylor blocks it to the right side of the bowler and gets to the other end.
Short and outside off, pushed to third man for a single.
Quick run! Full and around off, it is pushed towards extra cover for one.
EDGY FOUR! Flatter and just outside off, Madhever looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge that races away to the third man fence. 78 more needed in 9 overs.
FOUR! Nice stroke for a boundary! Short and around off, Wesley punches it through the covers. The deep cover fielder runs to his right and dives to stop but fails to do so.
Short and outside off, punched through covers for one.
Tossed up around off, driven through the covers for one.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Edged but lucky there! Floated around off, Wesley prods forward to drive but gets an inside edge which just about goes safely past the stumps.
Powerplay 3 Time! 5 fielders now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
A single and Taylor does not want the risk of taking two here. Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a run. Wesley wanted the second but Taylor rightfully sends him back.
Good length ball around off, pushed to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Absolutely effortless from Taylor. He moves to 93 now. Full and around off, a lofted on-drive, over Afridi at mid on, a boundary.
Good length and outside off, stylishly driven through the covers but just the single.
Slash and a miss! Outside off, Wesley Madhevere slashes hard at it but misses. It keeps low on the way to the keeper, the ball.
Full and around off, driven to cover.
Single to end the over as the last ball is pulled down to deep square leg. 95 needed in 66 balls.
Short and around off, Wesley looks to pull but gets an inside edge on the pad.
Full and outside off, it is lofted over cover for a single.
Short ball down the leg side, Taylor looks to pull but mistimes it. It rolls towards fine leg and they get two.
Short and around off, pushed down to third man for a single.
Good length and outside off, tapped through cover-point for an easy run.
WIDE! Length ball down the leg side. Taylor misses his flick. Wided.
Length and around off, pushed towards the off side for one.
FOUR! Nicely done! Banged short and on midddle, Taylor lets the ball come close and then helps it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
EDGY RUN! Full and outside off, Taylor looks to drive it over the off side but gets a thick outside edge that goes uppishly towards Wahab for one at third man.
Good length and just outside off, tapped through the covers for one.

NOT OUT! No spike as the ball goes past the bat. Short and wide outside off, Madhevere gives it a charge and looks to slam it on the leg side but misses. An appeal but it is turned down. Pakistan opt for the review but to no avail as there is no spike on Ultra Edge.
Review time! Pakistan take a review as they had appealed for a caught behind, which was turned down by the on-field umpire. Has he nicked it? Ultra Edge is in.... FLAT LINE! Pakistan lose the review!
Faheem Ashraf is back to continue. 7-1-34-0 for him.

In the air... safe! Short ball on middle, Madhevere goes for the pull. It hits the upper part and balloons towards mid-wicket. Zaman, the sub, runs forward from deep mid-wicket comes forward running in but fails to gather the ball.
Play and a miss! Good length and outside off, Madhevere looks to drive on the up but misses.
Shortish and outside off, guided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Fine stroke! Fuller and just outside off, Taylor slams it wide of the man at mid-wicket and it races away to the fence.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.

In the air.... but safe! Slower ball on off, change of pace from Shaheen Afridi. Taylor looks to play that on the leg side but is deceived by the slowness. Gets it off the top edge but luckily for him, it falls safe in the mid-wicket region. Takes a run.
Fuller in length on middle and leg from over the wicket, watchfully defended.
Short ball, pulled to deep square leg for a single. That brings up the 50-run partnership between these two as well. Excellent from them.
Good length ball around off, driven on the off side.
Yorker on off, dug out on the off side for a single. Good delivery from Shaheen.
Full and around off from round the wicket, Brendan goes for the big heave on the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Afridi gets to the ball quickly to prevent a single from being taken.
Another lovely ball. Full and outside off, Wesley looks to drive yet again and once again, he is beaten.
Play and a miss! Full and outside off, Madhevere looks to drive again but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.

BEATEN! The trademark delivery from Haris Rauf, the one that leaves the batsman late. Lands it outside off and gets it to seam away further. Wesley looks to drive on the up but is comprehensively beaten.
Length ball around off, tapped in front of point for a dot.
Full on middle, played to square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, stroked through the covers for a single.
Haris Rauf is back to bowl. 6-1-38-0 for him. Can he get the big fish, Brendan Taylor?

DRINKS! Zimbabwe need 121 runs in 96 balls. The required rate is 7.5, it was well under control earlier but now, it has started to climb upwards primarily due to the loss of wickets. But then, Taylor is there in the middle, at 71 and Madhevere is well set too. The former being an experienced international cricketer, would have seen many such situations previously and it is time for him to get those learnings here to guide his side safely home, without any hiccups. Can he? Let's find out after the break...
A dot to end. Short ball on top of the stumps, Taylor looks to guide that over the keeper's head, to the third man region, but fails to connect.
Full and outside off, stroked to the left of mid off for one.
Very full on off, driven towards mid off. They look for a single but the fielder was quick to the ball and spoils their plans.
Full and around off, driven to mid off.
Outside off, cut but straight to point.
Full on middle from round the wicket, driven to the right of mid on for a quick one.
A dot to end then. Full and outside off, driven to cover-point. Wesley says no to a run.
Fullish and outside off, driven to cover. A single.
FOUR! Yup, very, very clever from Brendan Taylor. He moves to the off side, it was a full ball outside off, he ramps it to the fine leg boundary.
Full on middle and leg, clipped to the leg side for a single.
Fullish and outside off, cut to point.
Full and outside off, driven to the left of sweeper cover for a brace.
SIX! BOOM! Slower through the air, full and outside off, Taylor slams it over long on for a biggie. 150 up for Zimbabwe as well.
Goes for the sweep again but it goes to the short fine leg fielder. They take a quick run.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and outside off, Taylor drags it over square leg and into the fence in the deep via a sweep. Fine shot.
Shortish and just outisde off, guided to short third man.
On middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Flatter and around off, punched to the cover fielder.

Excellent running! A length ball on middle, Madhevere tucks it towards mid-wicket gently. They take one and go for the second. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but Madhevere is in easily. And the ball deflects off the stumps and goes towards third man. They run an overthrow.
FOUR! Pulled aaway! Short ball on middle, not too pacy from Faheem. It sits up nicely for the pull. Madhevere pulls it firmly to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
Shortish and outside off, blocked.
Uppish but safe! Short and on middle, Taylor looks to pull but mistimes it uppishly towards square leg. It falls safe. A single.
Short and wide outside off, pushed to deep cover for one.
Around off on a good length, pushed towards the cover fielder.
Faheem Ashraf is back to bowl. 5-1-17-0 for him. Very commendable but can he get wickets now?
Dot! Just 2 off the over. Flatter and just outside off, Taylor blocks it out.
Full and around off, pushed towards the cover fielder.

In the air... put down! Good effort from Wahab though. Floated outside off on a fullish length, Taylor goes for the slog sweep but gets a top edge. Wahab runs from fine leg to catch but fails to hold on.
One more dot. Flat and on middle, blocked towards mid-wicket.
On middle, flicked straight to the square leg fielder.
Flatter and around off, forced off the back foot towards cover for one.
Single to end the over. Short and on middle, Madhevere tucks it towards the leg side and keeps the strike for the next over.
FOUR! Pulled! Short and on middle, Madhevere gets in position early and powers it over square leg for a boundary.
Length ball around off, blocked.

EDGY FOUR! Another slip and it would've gone straight to the fielder. Full and wide outside off, Madhevere looks to drive away from his body. He gets a thick outside edge that flies past the diving slip fieder and into the fence at third man.
Around off, blocked off the back foot.
BEATEN! Full and outside off, Wesley looks to drive but the ball sneaks under his blade and goes to the keeper.
Dot to end! Flat and around off, pushed towards mid off for nothing.
Flatter and around off, blocked back to the bowler.

FOUR! No one is stopping that. Tossed up and around off, Taylor nails the sweep through square leg and finds the fence. That brings up Taylor's half ton, his 39th in the ODIs. He will look to carry on though.
Superb stop at point. Short ball outside off, Taylor slaps it off his back foot but Imam at point dives to his left and saves a boundary for his side.
Tossed up and outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Full and on the pads, Taylor looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad.
Floated on off, blocked from within the crease.
Outside off, left alone.
Wesley Madhevere joins Brendon Taylor out in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Sean Williams goes after making just 4. Wahab Riaz gets the breakthrough for Pakistan. Good catch from Rizwan as well. Length ball outside off, takes Williams by surprise as he was anticipating a fuller one. Gets the outside edge and goes just over Rizwan's head, who jumps and takes it cleanly. 167 runs needed in 140 balls for Zimbabwe still.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Shortish ball on middle and leg, Sean looks to defend it but the bounce takes him by surprise. It takes the splice and goes behind square on the leg side. A single taken.
On the pads, tucked to fine leg for one.
On middle, Williams is solid in defense.
Full and around middle, it is eased down to long on for one.
Flatter and around off, blocked back to the bowler.
Beaten! Shortish and just outside off, breaks away after pitching. Taylor fails to put bat on ball.
Floated around off, pushed towards point for a quick run.
Full and outside off, Taylor looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge. It goes towards short fine leg for one.
Tight run. Length and just outside off, it is tapped wide of the point fielder. Quick run taken. 173 more needed in 25 overs.
Shortish and around off, blocked towards cover.
Back of a length and outside off, forced through cover-point for one.
Sharp bouncer! It is just outside off, Williams does well to drop his hands in time.
Short and outside off, Williams punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone.
Wahab Riaz is back to bowl now. 4-0-18-0 are his figures so far.
Floated on middle and leg, Williams eases it through mid on and gets off the mark. Just the single from the over.
Flat and outside off, Williams lets it be.
Floated on middle, Sean flicks but finds square leg.
Leading edge. Full and on middle, Williams looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge wide of the cover fielder. Luckily for him, it lands safe.
On middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven well but straight to the cover fielder.

SIX! Fine shot! Excellent use of the speed of the bowler by Taylor. Short and just around off, Taylor first tries to sway away but at the last moment, guides it over the keeper's head. It sails over the fence.
Good length and just outside off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
Full and around off, flicked to mid on.
WIDE! Banged short but it goes way down the leg side. Taylor lets it go to the keeper. Wided. 100 up for Zimbabwe.
Full and around off, a solid block from Brendan.
Full on off, blocked to the off side.
Outside off, punched to point.
Who will be the new man in? Sean Williams it is.

OUT! TAKEN! Imad Wasim gets the breakthrough for his side. Finally, the partnership is broken. Craig Ervine normally plays the reverse sweep well, but not this time. Tossed up around off, he goes for the reverse sweep, gets it uppishly, but just to the left of short third man. Haris Rauf moves there and takes it with ease. 183 runs needed in 168 balls for Zimbabwe still.
Tossed up on off, pushed to mid on for a dot this time.
Flighted on off, pushed to mid on for a single.
Tossed up on off, defended back to the bowler.
Floated around off, Taylor works it off the inner half to short fine leg. Looks for a single but there was none there.
Full and around off, dabbed to the off side.
And, another short ball. Craig sits under it yet again. A hat-trick of short balls to finish.
Another short ball, Craig Ervine ducks under it.
Short ball, Ervine sits under it.
Outside off, punched to point.
Length ball around off, stroked straight to Imam-ul-Haq at backward point.
Length ball around off, Craig defends it back on the pitch. Says no to his partner for a run.
Dot to end the 20th over. Full and on middle, it is flicked towards mid-wicket. 184 needed in 30 overs.
On middle, clipped through square leg for one.

Dropped? Imad thinks so as he has both his hands on his head. Shortish and just outside off, Ervine looks to cut it off the back foot but misses. Rizwan fails to collect the ball. Imad thinks that there was a tickle and replays later on confirm why he was disappointed. This can be a costly miss for Pakistan.
Flatter and outside off, stroked down to long off for one.
Another fuller one, this one is played towards the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Classic! Floated full and on middle, Taylor picks it up and flicks it over mid-wicket and it races away to the fence.
Dot to end a tidy over from Rauf. Length and around off, it is pushed towards the mid on fielder.
On off, it is blocked.
Shortish and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Mild LBW appeal. Shortish and on the pads, Ervine fails to block and is hit on the pad. An appeal but not out says the umpire. Looked to be pitching outside leg.
Short and wide outside off, stroked to deep cover for one.
Length ball around off, pushed towards mid on for nothing.
Haris Rauf is back to bowl. 3-0-30-0 for him so far. Vastly expensive. Somebody tell him this is not a T20. It is expensive even by a T20 standard.
Excellent stop! A certain boundary saved! Short and wide outsie off, Ervine slaps it to the left of the mid on fielder who makes a diving stop to his left. 3 from the first over of Imad.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
On middle, pushed through mid on for one.
Floated on off, it is knocked towards the off side. They go for the run. Rizwan quickly gets to the ball but the throw from him at the non-striker's end is a bad one.
Short and wide outside off to begin, Taylor pushes it down to sweeper cover and gets to the other end.
Imad Wasim to bowl now. Also, Ervine signals to the dugout for a change of bat for him.
Around off on a good length, blocked. 7 off the over.
Two more. Length and around middle and leg, it is worked towards deep square leg. The fine leg fielder fumbles and allows one extra.
Good length ball angled in, tucked through square leg for a couple.
WIDE! A bouncer on middle, Ervine sits under it. Wided as it goes way over the batter.
Short again, it is tucked towards square leg for one.
Back of a length ball around middle, it is kept out.
LEG BYE! Fullish ball on middle and leg, Craig looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It deviates after hitting the pads towards short third man and they sneak in a leg bye.

DRINKS! Zimbabwe are 81/2 at the end of 16 overs. They need 201 runs in 204 balls. Their start and play has been much better compared to Pakistan, as Taylor and Ervine are finding the boundaries fearlessly, despite the loss of 2 wickets early on. Now, they are looking a bit more dangerous as they have started to stroke more freely. But that presents an opportunity to Pakistan as well. Will they be able to cash in on that? Let's find out after the drinks break...
Dot to end the 16th over. Good length and just outside off, pushed towards the point fielder.
A single now as the length ball is forced wide of the man at mid on for one.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. It brings the 50-run stand too. Short and wide outside off, Ervine slaps it past the diving backward point fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Ervine breaks the shackles too. Full ball around off, Ervine launches it over the bowler's head and finds the fence.
Good length and on middle, played back to the bowler.
Length ball around off, blocked.
SIX! BOOM! Taylor says enough of this blocking. Gets a length ball right in the slot and thumps it over long off for a biggie.
Good length and around off, pushed towards mid off.
One more dot! 11th in a row. Length and just outside off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
Landed around off, blocked.
Excellent save! Shortish and just outside off, this one is punched wide of the point fielder. He dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Back of a length and outside off, punched towards the backward point fielder.
A maiden! Superb over from Faheem. Fullish and on off, Ervine comes forward and blocks.
Landed on a length and on middle, blocked. 5 dots so far.
Good length and on middle, tapped towards point for nothing.
Shortish and around off, Ervine punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Full and around middle, played back to the bowler.
Shortish and just around off, blocked.
A leave to end the over. It is wide outside off, Taylor lets it be.
Length and around off, blocked.
Gets a couple this time. Short and on middle, Taylor flicks it wide of the man at mid-wicket and gets two.
Back of a length ball on middle, pushed towards point.

Good length and on middle, it is tucked towards square leg, this time by the left-hander. They want two again but Rizwan, the keeper, hares across the ball and keeps it to one. He failed to get to the ball as the man from deep mid-wicket picked the ball but the keeper did well to put pressure on both the batters.
Quick single! A length ball on midde, Taylor tucks it towards square leg. Takes the first run quickly but settles with that only.
Very full and on middle, flicked to the man at mid on for nothing.
Full and wide outside off, Ervine goes for the expansive drive away from his body to get beaten.
Length ball around off, keeps low. Ervine does well to get hit bat down to block.
Around off, it is tucked towards square leg for a quick run.
Around off, solidly defended.
Fullish on the pads, flicked to fine leg for one.
A dot to end. Full and well outside off, Brendan covers his stumps and drives but straight to the man at short cover.
On the pads, defended.
Full and around off, Taylor looks to defend but misses again. Good bowling from Wahab Riaz.
BEATEN! Nice from Wahab. A back of a length ball outside off, a hint of movement from the surface as well. Taylor looks to drive it up on the up but is beaten completely.
Fullish and outside off, Taylor watchfully leaves it alone.
Length ball outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
WIDE! Bowls a good length ball but slips it a touch down the leg side, the batsman lets it be.
Powerplay 2 time! Now the field can relax a bit with 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the 40th over. Change in bowling too. Here's Wahab Riaz.

Three to finish what otherwise would have been a maiden over. Full on middle, Craig clips it towards deep square leg. It is racing away to the boundary but Afridi, who was at fine leg, runs and stops it. Saves one run for his side.
Full and outside off, driven but straight to cover-point.
On a length around off, blocked towards backward point.
BEATEN! Good length from Faheem. Bowls it full and well outside off, Craig looks to drive but misses it completely.
Shortish ball outside off, Ervine jumps and keeps it out.
On middle, tapped to the off side for a dot.
Around off on a good length, blocked.
On a length on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! This one is slipped down the leg side. Ervine looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Good response from Shaheen. Goes for the inswinging yorker but ends up bowling it very full on middle and leg, Craig looks to flick but gets an inside edge on the pad.
FOUR! SHOT! 50 up for Zimbabwe in style! A glorious stroke! Good length and outside off, it is driven on the up from Ervine. Finds the gap through the covers and it races away.
EDGY! Full and on middle, Taylor looks to flick but gets a thick outside edge. The ball races to the fence through cover-point. They run three before the fielder from the ring can get to the ball.
Full on off and middle, tapped to the right of the bowler who goes there and fetches it.
A dot to end. Full and around off, watchfully blocked off the front foot.
Fullish on the pads, Taylor looks to wrist it on the leg side but gets an inside edge. It goes to the left of the keeper and they take a quick single. Good running.
Full and around off, defended to mid off.
Outside off, Taylor shoulders arms.
Full on middle, Taylor uses his feet, comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for two.
Full on off, glanced to short mid-wicket.
Good shape and good leave from Ervine there. Lands around off and shapes away, Craig Ervine watchfully lets it be.
Pacy full ball around off, Craig just about keeps it out.

EDGY FOUR! Unfortunate for the bowler there. Full and around off, Craig covers the line of his stumps and looks to defend that. But the ball takes the outside edge and it goes past third slip to the third man fence.
Full and on the pads, flicked but straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, driven to mid off.

BEATEN! How does one play against Shaheen Afridi? No clue. That is what Ervine was also under. On a length around off, pitches and seams away, beating the outside edge of Ervine as he tried to poke at it.
Outside off, left alone. 10 off the over.
On the pads again, it is clipped for two towards fine leg.
FOUR! Poor bowling and Taylor is punishing him. Full and on the pads, Taylor once again clips it wide of the fine leg fielder. The fielder dives to his left to stop but misses.
Shortish and around off, blocked.
FOUR! SHOT! Brilliant shot! Too full and on middle, Taylor flicks it through square leg and finds the fence. Superb use of the wrists from him.
Good length and around off, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Beaten! Superb delivery to end the over! Just outside off on a good length, Ervine looks to defend but gets beaten. End of a successful over from Shaheen.
Terrific yorker! Taylor does well to dig it out to deep square leg for one.
Brendon Taylor is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED! Inside edge but that does not matter. Chamu Chibhabha, the skipper, is gone for 13. Full and around off, Chamu's eyes lit up on seeing the fuller length, he goes for the drive, but gets an inside edge. Unlucikly for him, it goes onto hit the stumps. Some days they go to the fine leg boundary. This was not such a day.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call on hitting the wickets. Chibhabha survives. Shortish ball around mdiddle, Chibhabha looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads. A loud, loud appeal from the bowler but it is turned down. Babar has a word with the bowler and the keeper and then he takes it upstairs. Replays roll in. No bat involved. But umpire's call on hitting the wickets. The onfield call stays. Good review from Pakistan though.

Review time! Pakistan have opted a review for the LBW decision that went against them. What does technology have to say? No spike on the Ultra Edge. That is clear then. In comes Ball Tracker and... UMPIRE'S CALL!
Bouncer on middle and leg, Chibhabha sits under it.
Good length and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
A dot to end. Full and on off, watchfully defended.

Good fielding, just a couple. Full and outside off, Craig steers it to the left of third man. It is racing away for a boundary but Riaz gets there and dives to stop it. Keeps it down to just a couple.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished. Ervine cuts it in front of point for a boundary.
Shortish and pacy outside off, Ervine lets it be. Good carry through to the keeper there.
Well outside off but within the tramline on a length, the batsman lets it be.
Full on middle and leg, closes the face of his bat to flick it to short mid-wicket. A single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Chamu misses to glance at it.
FOUR! Boundary to end the third over. Full and on middle and leg, Craig Ervine flicks it nicely, to the deep square leg boundary.
Full on the pads, Chibhabha misses his flick. It comes off his pads to the leg side and they take a leg bye.

BEATEN! Cut him in half. Afridi gets it to land around off, it pitches and nips back in a little with good pace. Chamu looks to play at it but misses it completely. The Pakistani players appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Azam does not opt to review at that.
Full and around off, pushed through the covers for a single.
BEATEN! Afridi is a very dangerous prospect as far as the batsmen are concerned. Fulllish and outside off, Craig looks to have a poke at it but misses.
Good length ball angled in, Ervine keeps it out.
A dot to finish. Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
FOUR! This one is a high quality shot. Length ball around off, Chamu Chibhabha stands tall and punches it through the cover region for a boundary.

FOUR! Get a third slip in, Pakistan! Full and swinging away outside off, Chamu drives at it but gets a thick outside edge. It flies past where third slip normally would have been and goes into the third man boundary.
BEATEN, AGAIN! Testing couple of deliveries for Chamu! Full and swinging away outside off, Chamu Chibhabha looks to have a poke at it but is beaten by the away swing.
BEATEN! Good comeback from Haris. Lands it on off and gets it to nip away a touch. Chibhabha looks to have a poke at it but is beaten.
FOUR! Slapped! Full and shaping away outside off, Chamu slaps it through the covers for a boundary.
Who will bowl from the other end? Will it be the debutant Rauf? Yes, here he is.
Outside off on a good length, Craig lets it be. Good start for Pakistan, just the 2 runs and the wicket of Brian Chari in it.
Outside off, well left by Ervine.
Play and a miss! Afridi is well on fire here. Lands it around off, it pitches and seams away, beating the outside edge of Ervine as he looked to play at it.
Who will be the new man in? Craig Ervine it is, in very early.

OUT! TIMBER! Shaheen Afridi strikes with the new ball. Chari's stay at the crease is very shortlived. Full and swinging in to middle, Chari looks to have a poke at it but misses due to the swing and the stumps behind are shattered.
Chari and Zimbabwe are underway then, with a couple. Very full on middle and leg, flicked to deep square leg for a couple.

We are all set for the chase to begin then! 282 is the target for Zimbabwe. The Pakistani players are in a huddle near the ropes as the umpires make their way out to the middle. Pakistan need to get a good breakthrough with the new ball in their hands. Zimbabwe's openers, Chamu Chibabha and Brian Chari are making their out to the middle as well. Shaheen Afridi with the new ball for Pakistan. Here he comes...
Starts off in the channel outside off, left alone by the batsman.
